head.h1: Anniversary Catering in Dubai — Menus, Prices and What's Included

opening_paragraph: Anniversary catering in Dubai from myCHEF is a vetted private chef at your home, villa or venue, from AED 700 per person. The chef designs the menu, cooks on site, serves each course and clears away. MyCHEF turns the date into a proper evening, whether it is a candlelit dinner for two or the whole family around one long table. You send the date, the guest count and the address; during our published business hours a written proposal you can read back lands promptly. A milestone dinner should belong to you instead of to the kitchen.

new_paragraphs: How much does anniversary catering cost in Dubai?

Drop-off starts from AED 90 per person and a buffet from AED 120 per person. A chef cooking and plating on site runs AED 700 to AED 950 per person, and a chef's tasting evening is around AED 1400. Catering formats start at 10 guests, 20 for a buffet, with a minimum order of AED 900. Send your numbers for an itemised quote.
What is included in an anniversary catering package?
Included is menu design, the chef on site, service staff, all plating and the full setup and cleanup. One team covers the evening from arrival to the last cleared plate, so you host without working.
How far ahead should I book anniversary catering?

Book as early as you can. A plated dinner for two is often possible at 48 hours' notice, a larger catered anniversary sits nearer 5 to 7 days, and peak dates around New Year and Valentine's go earlier still. Lead times depend on guest numbers, menu complexity, staffing, equipment, location and partner availability, and short-notice requests are assessed individually.
What is the leading catering company in Dubai?

No single company leads catering in Dubai. The market splits between hotel banqueting teams, high-volume caterers and chef-led operators such as myCHEF, and each is built for a different job, so the honest answer is that the right choice depends on your event. Lists titled "top 10 catering companies in Dubai" rarely state how the order was decided, so read them as a starting point, not a verdict. For an anniversary at home, judge on what you can check yourself: an itemised price, a chef who cooks on site, a named licensed kitchen behind the booking, and one person accountable for the night.
Can you cook the anniversary dinner at home?
Yes. The chef cooks in your own kitchen or a villa kitchen, so anniversary home catering happens in your space with restaurant-standard plating and no delivery reheating.
Do you cater corporate anniversary events?
Yes. Corporate anniversary catering covers company milestones, from canapé receptions to seated dinners, scaled to your headcount across offices, venues and rooftops in Dubai.
Can the menu handle dietary needs?

Every anniversary menu is built to your table. Vegetarian, vegan, halal and allergen-aware courses are planned in from the start, not added as an afterthought. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
Which areas of Dubai do you cover?
Chefs travel across Dubai, including Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, Downtown, Emirates Hills, Jumeirah and Business Bay, for homes, villas, yachts and private venues.
For anniversary catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

Chefs travel across the whole city, so the dinner comes to you instead of the other way round. Popular locations include Palm Jumeirah and Emirates Hills villas, Dubai Marina and JBR apartments with a view, Downtown and Business Bay penthouses, and Jumeirah and Arabian Ranches family homes. The service also works on yachts and at private beach and desert venues for couples who want the setting to be part of the story. Because the chef cooks in your kitchen, anniversary home catering runs in your own space with restaurant-standard plating and none of the reheating that comes with delivery.

Outdoor catering in Dubai is its own planning job, and it is worth being honest about the season. Between roughly November and March a garden, terrace, rooftop or private beach setting holds an evening comfortably from sunset onwards. In high summer the same setup needs shade, cooling and a much shorter service window, or the food moves indoors and only the toast happens outside. Wherever you put the table, an outdoor service needs a level surface for the cooking station, power within cable reach, and a route from the van or the kitchen that does not run through your guests. Tell us the spot when you enquire and the plan is built around it instead of discovered on the night. Explore romantic dinner , engagement and birthday catering options, browse all event catering , or see the full range of catering in Dubai . Wherever you are in the emirate, the plan is the same: a vetted chef, a menu you approve and an evening you get to spend at the table.

Milestone family celebrations, from a 25th to a 50th, sit better as a shared feast or a relaxed buffet where several generations eat together. Corporate anniversary catering marks a company's year, a partnership or a store opening, and scales to a canapé reception or a seated dinner for the team. MyCHEF also handles the anniversary party catering end of things, where a DJ, a cake and a crowd need catering that keeps pace with the room. Whether the guest list is two or two hundred, and whether you want anniversary catering for events across offices, rooftops or private villas, the format follows the occasion instead of forcing it into one shape. Tell us the mood and the numbers, and the plan is built to match.

add_block.new_heading: Where can I celebrate my anniversary in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Most people start by looking for an anniversary restaurant in Dubai, and for a quiet dinner for two on a weeknight a good table is often the right answer. The calculation changes with the guest list and with what you want the evening to feel like. Restaurants give you a view, a room someone else resets and no one in your kitchen; against that, you get the table for a fixed window, you eat what the set menu says on a peak date like Valentine's or New Year's Eve, and one of you drives home. Celebrating at your own place gives you the menu you chose, your own music, children asleep upstairs, and an evening that ends when you decide. Home tends to win outright once the party passes eight people, because restaurants at that size push you to a private room with a minimum spend, and it wins again for a surprise, for a milestone with three generations at the table, and for anything with real dietary requirements. Beyond your own address, anniversaries in Dubai are commonly hosted in a rented villa, on a chartered yacht, in a desert camp or at a private beach setting, and a chef travels to all of them. We set the trade-offs out in full in our guide to a private chef versus a restaurant in Dubai .

add_block.new_heading: What is on the anniversary catering menu?
new_paragraphs: Every anniversary menu is bespoke, built around your tastes instead of a fixed list. As a starting point, couples often choose a plated multi-course dinner, a canapé and champagne-style reception, or a grazing spread followed by a celebration dessert. The chef can cook Italian and Mediterranean, French, modern Emirati, Arabic mezze, Indian or pan-Asian, and can theme the anniversary food around the cuisine of your first date or your wedding. Popular courses include fresh seafood, slow-cooked short rib, handmade pasta, a mezze table and a plated dessert finished at the table. The full anniversary menu, ingredients and any wine or mocktail pairings are set during planning, so you approve every course before the date. Dietary needs are built in from the first draft, not left to a single side dish set aside: vegetarian, vegan, halal and allergen-aware versions of each course. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event. If there is a dish that means something to the two of you, the kitchen will recreate it.

new_paragraphs: Beyond the plates, the evening is shaped by how it is set and paced. The chef and service team can dress the table, time each course to the moment, and coordinate with a florist, a cake or a musician you have booked separately. For a surprise, the team arrives and sets up while you keep your partner out of the room, then serves on cue. Halal kitchens, alcohol-free menus and quiet, discreet service are all standard on request, which suits family and faith-observant celebrations. If children are at the table, a simpler parallel menu keeps them fed and happy. All of it runs inside Dubai food-safety practice, and the allergen details you share are passed to the assigned culinary partner for review before the menu is signed off. The result reads as effort you did not have to spend, on the one evening you most want to be a guest at your own table.

add_block.new_heading: How much does anniversary catering in Dubai cost?
new_paragraphs: Anniversary catering in Dubai is priced per head, and the format sets the band. A chef cooking and serving on site starts from AED 700 per person and reaches around AED 950 per person for premium plated menus with full service. Where you are buying the food instead of a chef at the stove, the numbers sit far lower: drop-off from AED 90 per person, a standard anniversary buffet from AED 120 per person, and premium buffets, live stations or canapé receptions from AED 150 per person. Set anniversary catering packages run from AED 1200 for an intimate dinner up to AED 2400, AED 3600, AED 4500 and AED 5500 for larger seated events, and a chef's tasting evening is priced around AED 1400. Catering formats start at 10 guests, 20 for a buffet, with a minimum order of AED 900; a plated private-chef dinner has no minimum headcount, because a table for two is a real booking. Add 5% VAT to the total. Every anniversary catering price you are quoted is itemised line by line, so nothing hides inside a single lump figure. For a full breakdown of catering cost across formats, see our Dubai catering price guide or request an itemised quote for your date.
What will it cost to feed 40 guests?

Forty is the headcount we are asked to price most often, and the sum is the per-head rate multiplied by the guest list. To feed 40 guests from a standard buffet, the food line is 40 covers at AED 120 per person; live stations or a premium spread is 40 at AED 150 per person; a chef plating every course for a seated forty is 40 at AED 700 per person and upward. On top of the food line sit staffing and equipment, which is where the formats separate — a drop-off needs nobody on site, a buffet for forty needs one or two staff, and plated service for forty needs three or more. Add 5% VAT at the end. Give us the date and the number and the same arithmetic comes back to you itemised, so you can see which line to move if the total is not where you want it.
Is there a cheap anniversary catering option in Dubai?

Yes, and the honest lever is format, not a discount. A drop-off or buffet spread at AED 90 to AED 120 per person feeds the same guests the plated menu would; the money goes into food instead of service staff, and you handle the setting out and the clearing up. Keeping the chef but shortening the menu — three courses instead of five, one showpiece dish instead of three — is the other route, and it usually protects the evening better than dropping to the cheapest tier. What we will not do is publish a low headline and add staffing, equipment and travel back on afterwards; the quote you approve is the quote you pay, plus VAT.

add_block.new_heading: How to choose the best anniversary catering in Dubai
new_paragraphs: Nobody can hand you a ranking of anniversary caterers in Dubai, because the market is fragmented and most published lists do not say how the order was decided. What you can do is check five things before you pay a deposit. Is the price itemised, so you can see food, staff, equipment and travel as separate lines instead of one lump sum? Who cooks on the night — a chef working in your kitchen, or a van delivering trays that were finished hours earlier? Which licensed kitchen is assigned to your booking, and what food-safety approvals does it hold for the service it is performing? Is the menu written around your table, or is it last season's package with your date typed at the top? And is one named person accountable from the first enquiry to the last cleared plate, or does the booking pass between a salesperson, a kitchen and a service team who have not spoken to each other? Ask those five and the shortlist answers itself. Our longer checklist lives in the guide to choosing a caterer in Dubai .
